rationale: Rule 1: param_validation maps Type1-ish baseline High; Rule 2: collections+create is management plane (not search/insert/upsert/query/get), unchanged; Rule 3: no batch amplification (single-collection create); Rule 4: DOC_PARTIAL -1 level to Medium; Rule 5: single script trigger -1 level to Low; the code=65535 rejection on http 200 is an application error envelope, not a crash signal (no OOM/panic/5xx/reset/Killed), so the Rule 4 forced-Critical exception does not apply.
